description: S458 slice 2 (position 2): a struct value built at run time is judged field by field. show(h) builds `const l: Link = { href: h }` with Link.href: string(url); called with "https://scrml.dev/" it passes (@shown takes it), called with "javascript:alert(1)" the check throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT before `l` binds, so @shown keeps the https value.
